description: This PHP source file includes header and utility files, retrieves routing protocol configuration parameters, and generates a web interface for configuring RIP routing, including JavaScript for form handling and AJAX submission.

methods.name: initPopulate
methods.description: Initializes form fields with RIP configuration data from JavaScript object jsRIPEntry.

methods.name: initEventHandler
methods.description: Handles enabling/disabling authentication key input fields based on Authentication Type dropdown.

methods.name: saveRIP
methods.description: Sends the RIP configuration data via AJAX POST to server for saving, with validation feedback.
